parent_objective: focus source mining on terminal-margin near-cliff normal-success rows after broad-window mining found no accepted rows
blocked_by: M985 finds no accepted rows despite many action-threshold candidates; top margin gaps occur with too much terminal slack
invalidates: starting PPO from the M985 broad-window result
lowering accepted-row action or margin thresholds

public_gates: M986 must not use private holdout
M986 must preserve P0 actor-input contract
M986 must keep accepted-row action and margin thresholds unchanged
M986 may narrow the normal-success mining window to terminal-margin near-cliff rows
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters to actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_scenario_family: terminal-margin near-cliff proof mining over richer hidden-dynamics families
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: re-runs multi-family mining with normal_margin_max=0.20 to focus on low-slack rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: proof-surface mining only; no training, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if PPO or optimizer starts
stop if near-cliff mining also yields no accepted rows
fallback_plan: if source-diverse rows pass, route to compact corpus and exact objective sanity
if only isolated pockets appear, route to source-diversity expansion around those pockets
if no accepted rows appear, route to scenario range calibration or simulator fault-extension design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M985 broad-window source mining finds action separation but no outcome-sensitive rows

hypothesis: Extreme scenario-family wrong-history outcome sensitivity is concentrated near terminal-margin cliffs; restricting normal-success rows to margin <= 0.20 will reveal accepted rows without weakening accepted-row thresholds.
success_criteria: accepted rows and source diversity are reported by family
PPO and promotion are not used
